violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CORN AT 112F IN STEAM TABLE; RICE AT 121F IN COOKER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19.EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT FOODS TO 165F OR ABOVE FOR HOT HOLDING AT 135F OR ABOVE. RICE REHEATED TO 202F, CORN REHEATED TO 186F. EL FRESCO MEXICAN GRILL (Inspection Date: 05/21/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CUT TOMATOES AT 47F AND COOKED GROUND BEEF AT 51F IN TRUE 2 DOOR PREP TOP; DICED TOMATOES AT 47F, SOUR CREAM AT 44F, GRILLED CORN AT 47F, POTATOES AT 54F, MILK AT 47F, SOUR CREAM AT 44F IN AVANTCO 3 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION..

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: WALK IN REFRIGERATOR AND AVANTCO 2 DOOR PREP TOP (DINING).
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: AVANTCO 3 DOOR PREP TOP AT 42F UNABLE TO MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: DISHWASHING MACHINE UNABLE TO DISPENSE SANITIZER AT 50- 200PPM. SANITIZER MEASURED AT 0PPM AT END CLEANING CYCLE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCT PIC TO USE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK FOR SANITIZING DISHES AFTER WASHING AND RINSING WITH DISHWASHING MACHINE. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCED UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CUT TOMATOES AT 44F IN TRUE 3 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOUL ODOR EMANATING FROM GREASE TRAP IN FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE CLEANING SERVICE AND EMAIL EHS ONCE SERVICE HAS BEEN COMPLETED. EL FRESCO MEXICAN GRILL (Inspection Date: 11/24/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHRIMP AND FISH OVER COOKED CHICKEN IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: OBSERVED SALSA AT 45F PREPARED DAY BEFORE IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE APPROPRIATE METHODS ARE USED TO COOL FOODS PREPARED FROM AMBIENT TEMPERATURE TO 41F WITHIN 4 HOURS.
